rounds.text: Elixir Capital Ltd is currently positioned as a classic turnaround play, evidenced by the fact that profit growth has recently shifted to a positive 13% over the trailing twelve months [E21]. This momentum is further validated by the scanX signal engine, which identifies that profit growth is now outpacing price growth by 11%, signaling that the company is beginning to outperform market expectations [E55]. While the long-term historical profit growth has been negative [E18, E19, E20], the company is currently demonstrating a robust ability to generate returns, with an ROA of 2.43% that significantly exceeds the sector benchmark of 1.77% [E8]. Furthermore, the stock is trading at a P/B of 0.78x, which represents a substantial discount compared to the sector benchmark of 1.35x [E7]. Conceded: the company has faced long-term challenges with a 10-year compounded profit growth of -7% [E18] and poor 5-year sales growth of -7.87% [E60]. Despite these historical headwinds, the current valuation metrics suggest the market has yet to fully price in the recent shift toward positive profit growth [E21, E64].
